messages:
Rae (CSM): Kicking off Solstice Bio onboarding. Contract for Redwood Private (VPC) pilot; target pilot in 45 days. Top asks: SSO via SAML, EU data residency, BYOK + HSM proof-of-concept, and low-latency chat for support agents. Need owners, success metrics, and a risks column.

Zara (Customer PM): Solstice stakeholders: Mira (CTO), Jonas (Infra), Leila (ML), and Petra (Sec Ops). They want weekly status reviews on Fridays and a pilot decision at day 30.

Omar (Solutions): Proposed perf targets: p95 token latency < 140ms for 512 context; embeddings throughput >= 150 qps for batch queries. Will validate on staging after peering.

Luis (Onboard Eng): I'll handle VPC peering, staging cluster, and smoke tests. Need Jonas' CIDR + VPN cert. Plan: peering (day 3), staging up (day 8), smoke pass (day 12).

Ivy (Security): Compliance note: they require 13-month audit logs and evidence of SOC2. BYOK via Azure Key Vault preferred; external HSM may add integration time. Marking DPA/SOC2 as blocker until Legal confirms.

Hiro (Enablement): I'll prepare two sessions: 1) Platform intro + API quickstart, 2) Ops & cost control. Prefer Tue 10:00 CET for Solstice devs. Will record.

Rae (CSM): Action list (add to playbook link):
- Luis  network+staging (due day 3)
- Omar  perf targets + test plan (due day 7)
- Ivy  compliance & KMS plan (due day 6)
- Hiro  enablement materials + session (due day 5)
- Zara  stakeholder invites + procurement notes (due day 2)
Doc: https://docs.redwood.example/s/Solstice-onboard (please annotate).

Zara (Customer PM): Invited Mira, Jonas, Leila, Petra to first sync (Fri 09:00 CET). They confirmed Fri cadence. Jonas uploaded CIDR to the doc.

Omar (Solutions): I will add perf test harness for 512/1024 tokens and baseline memory/kv cache metrics by EOD.

Luis (Onboard Eng): Network snippet for playbook:
```
# minimal egress rules
allow: tcp 443 -> api.redwood.eu
allow: tcp 10250 -> metrics.redwood.internal
# request: provide PEM cert for SAML IdP
```

Ivy (Security): Request Solstice share their pen-test schedule and confirm whether Azure Vault is acceptable for BYOK. Also need to know if audit logs must be exported to their SIEM.

Rae (CSM): Ops question: if 13-month retention is required, is that an add-on? @Omar please confirm pricing delta so we can surface to the customer.

Omar (Solutions): Confirmed: 13-month retention is available as an add-on; I'll draft cost delta and add to the playbook.

Hiro (Enablement): Session scheduled Tue 10:00 CET and recorded; ops session scheduled Fri after the weekly sync. Slides uploaded.

Ivy (Security): Legal requested SOC2 excerpt; will upload once obtained. If DPA sign-off delayed, flag as renewal risk.

sched-bot: Created event "Solstice onboarding - kick" at 1799999640 (Fri 09:00 CET) with guests: Rae, Zara, Hiro, Mira, Jonas, Leila, Petra.

Zara (Customer PM): Procurement asked for draft DPA by next Tue; I've looped Legal.

Luis (Onboard Eng): Starting VPC peering ticket now that CIDR is in doc.

Omar (Solutions): Perf harness posted. Planning an initial smoke with 8 concurrent streams.

Ivy (Security): SOC2 excerpt uploaded to playbook; BYOK via Azure Vault looks acceptable to Solstice. Renewal risk lowered.

Rae (CSM): Great kickoff. Owners assigned, meetings scheduled, and playbook link shared. Tag blockers with #onboard-blockers. Closing kickoff thread and moving to weekly status updates. :tada:
